authority: Marcos, November 14, 2026 (relayed to this seat about 5 AM CT and again at 9:20 PM CT): this seat is to instrument a step of the loop and look at every opportunity to shorten it, and he expects a step in minutes. weight-research-astra, November 15, 2026 (records/retrospectives/2026-11-15-recorder-workers-result-astra.md): recorder-workers-original's result is accepted; three-worker kept generation may be prepared as a new reader protocol that keeps the historical control's, the generation's and the state reading's executions apart and carries the worker count and every scheduler context's account, without widening a check or relabelling the unchanged state reader as the workers recorder; before any candidate capture uses it, one integrated original-only qualification of all thirty fitting answers in the capture's three calls is declared and assessed, with complete case and output accounting against the qualified original acquisition, from bound control evidence where it exists and without running the installed comparison again for a timing; no quiet-machine repeat and no speed threshold is asked; the owner chooses the integration and supplies its source and protocol bindings before execution. The recorder, the engine's passes, the instruments and the placement on cards are this seat's (STATE.md, who holds what).
hypothesis: The project's hypothesis: a capability leaves a recurring difference between the traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that recurring difference lives repairs the capability. This run tests no part of it. It asks one thing of the instrument every step of a correction loop pays for: whether a step's capture, generated by three engine contexts at once, and the states kept from that generation's own streams are the original's own computation at every answer step and every question position of the thirty answers, with every call's and every context's account kept and every record saying which program computed what it holds.
why_this_direction: Steps 1 and 2 of the method are the overlaps of the full traces, and step 5 measures the computation again on the current model's own answers after every update: each such measurement is the engine's generation of the thirty fitting answers, from whose own streams the states are kept with no second pass (the stopped loop's first pass: generation 205.1 s, keeping the states 28.9 s). The generation is the largest part of a step (about 154 s of about 222 s before the write under controlled-bf16-8, as arithmetic). recorder-workers-original measured the one arrangement that shortens it without changing an answer's bytes: three contexts as threads of one process on the kept scheduler wrote ten answers in 37.65 s where the installed recorder took 79.38 s, 10 of 10 answers the installed recorder's four files. That was a component: ten answers, one call, a comparison harness. A step's capture is another program (thirty answers in three calls, a batch finished while the next is generated, every binding a capture closes with), and its states are then the WORKERS recorder's computation, which form 2 of the reader protocol cannot say and which states_reading.py and states_conditional_check.py refuse, as they should. A reading by a separate pass of the installed recorder would be honest too and is not what is prepared: that pass took 235.7 s for the original control, more than the generation it would follow. The protocol of form 3 and its programs are written and held on fixtures; what is missing between them and any use is this run, and Astra set it as the condition. The definition of the loss is open (the hold of 8:48 to 8:50 AM CT November 15); her decision says the instrument's preparation does not wait for it, and whichever measure is defined is read on a capture's states.
repeating_pattern_check: Seven things have happened more than once. (1) A component's qualification stood in for the whole: the kept scheduler was qualified on the recorder alone and no capture has yet run under controlled-bf16-8; the workers were qualified on ten answers in one call of a comparison harness. Why: the component was what could be compared cheaply. Here the capture program itself runs, all thirty answers in its three calls, and the states are kept and compared whole. (2) A record carried an identity it did not make: one execution for a capture and its reading. Why: the forms had one slot. Form 3 has the generation's and a reading's own, the reading kept here says its states are the generation's and names the workers recorder, and no file controlled-bf16-8 binds is edited. (3) Evidence was removed before the comparison was written (Astra's finding on recorders_beside.py, revision 1 of recorders-beside-original). Here the kept reading is whole on disk until the account is written; its arrays leave afterwards only where every row is the control's bits. (4) A helper source was loaded and not bound (revision 2 of recorder-workers-original). Here every file under records/ that the four steps load was listed from the programs' own imports before this declaration: each is an instrument of the protocol or is named under implementation.bound, and run.sh holds each to its sha256 before every step. (5) A timing on a loaded machine was read as a ratio. No ratio is formed here and the installed recorder is not run again: each call's seconds, the load average and the card's other processes are kept as evidence, and no time is a condition. (6) This seat's own file analyses ran on the comparison's processor threads (recorder-workers-original, inside workers-3). Nothing of this seat runs on threads 2,3,4,10,11,12 while the capture runs. (7) A path was priced by one part of it: this seat's own first form 3, committed and replaced the same morning before anything was sent or run, gave the state reading to a separate pass and would have lengthened a step. Why: the generation's seconds were looked at without the reading that follows it. Here the whole acquisition of a step is what runs: the generation and the states kept from it. (8) A boundary checked after the act, and a name standing for bytes: the first form of this declaration (6f0af390) held the original model and the fitting population only in the protocol's `held`, which runs after the capture and the reading, while the capture took a selection, a solver file and a pass from the environment; and it bound 26 files and left the remaining pipeline sources to the commit result.json would name, which does not hold a file modified in the shared tree. Astra's review found both before anything ran (records/retrospectives/2026-11-15-generation-workers-review-astra.md). Why it keeps happening: a check is placed where its inputs are easiest to read (after the records exist) and a list is made from what a seat remembers binding. Here the scope is held before acquisition in the acquiring process, and the bound list is computed from what the steps load and enforced at import.
what_went_wrong_before: Every construction so far repaired some answers and broke others; the repeated correction on state values was stopped in its first pass, and the relational loop under the fixed-mate envelope was stopped because its loss follows the words an answer uses. A step of a loop was 1 h 35 to 2 h in the on-policy loop and 44 to 52 minutes as the stopped loop's launcher stood; Marcos expects minutes. Of the measured attempts at the generation, two recorder processes beside each other were slower, reading the outputs back once a split gained 4%, computing a split as one graph gained a quarter and is adopted, and three contexts as threads of one process gained about a factor of two on ten answers and are not adopted: nothing has yet shown that a whole capture made that way, and the states kept from it, are the original's computation.

reader_protocol.role: the protocol of form 3 this run's capture and kept reading are held to. It binds no integrated qualification (its `integrated_qualification` is null) and so holds a capture of the original model only: this run is that qualification. controlled-bf16-8 is not changed and no file it binds is edited; a protocol that admits a changed state is another file, made only after this run's result is assessed.

inputs_read_for_what: The model is read by the workers recorder and never written. The cohort's declaration, the registered membership, the inputs' index and the wide overlap's members give the thirty fitting answers, their prompts' tokens, their recorded tokens and their limits (ladder.cohort, tube.picks, cases.chosen). Each fitting answer's exported folder holds the original's turns a computed registration would be laid on: hashed when the capture starts, read as arrays only if an answer's tokens are not the recordings'. whole-states-original/reading is the original control, the installed recorder's own pass of November 14 on the recordings' text, which the protocol names by its sha256: the kept reading's rows are compared with its rows, bit for bit. The two earlier qualifications' records are what generation_engine.py and recorder_engine.py read to say what the generation and the kept scheduler rest on. The answers no fit uses are not generated, read or listed; the reserved folder is not opened.
rule: Data roles: the thirty fitting answers of the cohort controlled-bf16-1 (tube.picks) and no others. The model is the original file, read only. Before the capture and again before the reading, in the process that runs them, the run's scope is held: the model file is the original by its sha256, the cohort is controlled-bf16-1, the selection is the fitting answers by the cohort itself and gives exactly the thirty answers `population` lists, in order, and nothing in the environment selects answers, another solver file, a pass, extra kept files or another lock; out of scope, no selected trace is opened and no recorder started. Every Python source a step loads is held to `implementation.bound` when it is loaded. Four steps, in this order. `capture`: own_text_workers.py generates each fitting answer from its prompt alone, greedy, up to the recordings' own limit, ten answers a recorder call, each call three contexts of the workers recorder on the kept scheduler (generation_engine.Generation) under card 0's lock; the streams are kept in <run>/streams; beside it the card is asked every 3 s what its processes hold. A call that does not say it ran three workers, did not take each of its cases once, or has a scheduler context without its totals or off the qualified path ends the capture where it stands, and nothing partial is used. `reading` (files only, no pass): states_reading_roles.py keeps the generation's own streams as <run>/reading, after holding the capture to the generation's identity and every call's account; the reading says its states are kept from the generation and names the workers recorder. `held` (files only): reader_protocol_roles.py holds the capture and the reading kept from it to the protocol's generation execution. `account` (files only): generation_qualification.py holds every call's account, each answer to one worker of one call and to the recording's tokens, and compares the kept reading with whole-states-original/reading at every row both computed from one input (every question position and every answer step), at every merge and in both terminal arrays, bit for bit; an answer with a row that is not the control's bits is named in compare/integrated.json with its count. That comparison is across two executions, the workers recorder on the kept scheduler and the installed recorder on the installed engine, and says so with the keys that differ: it is this run's subject. The installed recorder is not run again; no time and no card memory is a condition. At the close, where every row is the control's bits, the kept reading's arrays are removed by this seat (they are the control's, kept in whole-states-original/reading and in the bucket) and reading.json and row-map.json stay; where a row is not, the reading stays whole. Nothing measured here starts, stops or selects a correction, a reference, a tolerance or a loss, and nothing is adopted by it: a protocol that admits a changed state is made only after Astra assesses result.json.

prediction.1_capture: 30 of 30 answers registered by the identity of their inputs with the recordings (their tokens are the recordings', 14,592 answer steps), in three calls of ten; each call says it ran 3 workers, takes each of its ten cases once, and leaves 9 schedulers' totals, every one with no split unmarked and every split one range. Held on recorders-beside-original (the installed recorder's capture on card 0: 30 of 30 by identity) and recorder-workers-original (three kept workers: 10 of 10 answers the installed recorder's four files). Held with less confidence than a repeat would be: answers 11 to 30 have never been generated by the workers recorder, and the capture finishes a batch while the next call runs, which the comparison harness did not do.
prediction.2_reading_and_held: states_reading_roles.py keeps all thirty streams (19,751 rows at 105 merges and the two terminal arrays), finding at every row the engine's ADD made again from its two recorded operands to be the kept row; reader_protocol_roles.held takes the capture and that reading as the protocol's generation (the workers recorder, its libraries, 3 workers, every call's account), bound to each other by the capture's text.json.
prediction.3_account: every row is the original control's bits: 19,751 rows (14,592 answer steps and 5,159 question positions) at all 105 merges, l_out at 19,751 rows and result_norm at 14,592; 30 of 30 answers at the original's computation, `apart` empty. recorders-beside-original found exactly this for the installed recorder's own generation under controlled-bf16-7; three kept workers wrote the installed recorder's stream bytes for ten of these answers. What has not been done before is the other twenty answers and a second and third call.
prediction.not_predicted: the seconds. Each call's seconds, the capture's parts, the reading's seconds, the load average and the card's readings are recorded. Ten answers took 37.65 s in recorder-workers-original's one call on a loaded machine; what thirty take in three calls with a model load in each is not extrapolated into a prediction, and no time decides anything here.

would_weaken_it: Nothing here bears on the hypothesis. On the instrument: (1) a row of an answer that is not the control's bits means a step's states made by three contexts are another computation for that answer as far as the record goes: the workers path is used for no capture, the reading stays whole, and the merge, the rows and the largest difference are named. (2) An answer whose tokens are not the recordings' means the generation worded it otherwise than the installed recorder does on this card: closed as (1). (3) A call without a context's totals, off the qualified path, or not accounting for each case once ends the capture; the run closes with what ran and nothing of it is used. (4) A kept row that is not the engine's ADD of its two recorded operands is states_reading_roles.py's own refusal: the stream is not what the reader takes it for, and the run closes there. (5) The protocol refusing the capture or the reading means the records the programs write are not the ones form 3 holds: a defect of this seat's source, fixed and declared again, with no execution relabelled to pass. (6) A crash, a hang or a refused context is recorded as it stands. (7) A step ended by the scope check or by a source that is not bound at its bytes is no result about the instrument: nothing was acquired by that step, the run closes with what ran, and a new revision is declared before anything starts again.

implementation.how: run.sh in this folder, one step at a time, each step `records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/generation_qualification.py <step> generation-workers-original <protocol>` after run.sh has unset every override the bound sources read from the environment. `capture`: the scope is held, then own_text_workers.py is run in that process as the declaration names it (the population's cohort, `original`, `recordings`, <run>/own), with KEEP_RAW=<run>/streams, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and the lock's card from the population's card (each recorder call under card 0's lock through records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/after-the-others.sh 0, as a loop's launcher runs a capture), and `python3 -I records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/generation_qualification.py watch 0` beside it. `reading`: the scope is held again, then states_reading_roles.py with ROLLOUTS=<run>/streams and the capture's folder as its text (no card). `held`: reader_protocol_roles.held, written to qualification/held-by-the-protocol.json. `account`: generation_qualification.account, which also carries the two scope records and how many sources each step loaded. Each step leaves logs/<step>.sources.json (what it loaded, each at the bound sha256) and capture and reading leave logs/<step>.scope.json. result.json is written at the close from those records.
implementation.bound_is: 54 Python sources: the actual source closure of the four steps, as `generation_qualification.py closure` lists it (every file of the path-forward folder a step's program names in an import at any depth, and every file of code/signal-trace those name with everything importing it loads, the research verifier included), and 7 more: the two recorders, after-the-others.sh, run.sh and three instruments of the protocol that no step loads. run.sh holds each of them and the protocol file to these sha256 before every step. Beyond that, each step holds every Python source of the repository it actually loads to this list when it is loaded (generation_qualification.Held): a file not here, or here at other bytes, is not loaded and the step ends. No commit's name stands for a file's bytes. A file of code/signal-trace that a bound module loads only inside a function no step calls is not listed (the four such are correction.py, gap_late.py, success_sets.py and recorder_identity.py, reached from gap_rows.beside, gap_run.main, gap_run.reference and tube.same_program, which the solver's own commands call and these steps do not); were a step to reach one it would end there, and the run would close with what ran.
